# DYTRONICS

> DYTRONICS is a Lagos, Nigeria electronics shop selling components, modules, tools and repair parts. Same-day dispatch in Lagos and nationwide shipping.

## Key pages
- [Home and shop](https://www.dytronics.name.ng/): storefront with category browsing and cart
- [All products](https://www.dytronics.name.ng/products/): every product with its price
- [Sitemap](https://www.dytronics.name.ng/sitemap.xml)
- [Privacy](https://www.dytronics.name.ng/privacy.html)
- [Terms](https://www.dytronics.name.ng/terms.html)

## Good to know
- Every product has its own page at https://www.dytronics.name.ng/p/<product-name>/ with price, stock status and description.
- Prices are in Nigerian naira (NGN).
- Orders can be placed through the website cart or on WhatsApp (+234 705 437 8193).
- Delivery: Lagos usually 1-3 days after order confirmation; nationwide typically 3-5 working days.
- The account and admin pages are private and not meant for indexing.
